prompts.title: Slow Cinematic Push-In
prompts.prompt: Using the supplied football input image, create a 6-second vertical 9:16 hyperrealistic animation with a slow cinematic camera push-in. The camera glides gently toward the main visible subject, keeping the existing composition, kits, colours, flags and crests exactly as shown. Add subtle natural breathing and very small torso or shoulder shifts only if the reference supports them. If a ball or foot is visible, let it move minimally in a physically plausible way; otherwise keep motion atmospheric, such as slight grass or fabric movement. Maintain stable anatomy and legible faces. Keep the lower frame relatively clear for subtitles. Do not invent players, crowd details, scores, statistics or identities. No generated text, narration or music; the downstream edit adds audio.

prompts.title: Smooth Lateral Tracking
prompts.prompt: From the supplied football input image, generate a 6-second vertical 9:16 hyperrealistic clip using a smooth lateral camera tracking move. The camera slides sideways at a restrained, broadcast-like pace, with gentle parallax between the existing foreground and background elements. Players or officials visible in the reference may make small, physically coherent sports movements, such as a short step, slight turn or modest arm swing, while anatomy remains stable and faces stay legible. Preserve all original kits, colours, flags and crests. Do not reveal areas or people absent from the image, and do not invent events, scores, statistics or identities. Keep the lower frame free for subtitles. No generated text, narration or music; the downstream edit adds audio.
